name: LMGram
description: LMGram helps Claude turn concise user intent into opt-in human match requests. Users can create a request from a minimized conversation summary, review recent match requests, and start lightweight chats with matched people. It is designed for finding collaborators, mentors, peers, helpers, beta testers, or domain experts without sharing raw transcripts or unnecessary private context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LMGram to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LMGram to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.lmgram.com/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LMGram MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LMGram provides these MCP tools: get_current_user, request_human_match, list_match_requests, start_chat, list_messages, and send_message.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LMGram?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LMGram in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
LMGram requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LMGram is developed by Sicose S.A.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
